create_gaussian_kernel: create a 2D Gaussian kernel tensor using gkern2d with configurable kernel size and sigma
build_bilateral_filter: build a BilateralFilter neural module for edge-preserving image smoothing with spatial and color sigma parameters
crop_images_using_mask: crop a list of images and camera matrices using bounding boxes derived from binary mask tensors
resize_image_tensor: resize a PyTorch image tensor with bilinear interpolation supporting both NCHW and NHWC formats
pad_image_to_divisor: pad a PyTorch image tensor to dimensions divisible by a specified integer using constant padding
